text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival. It's a festival where the Umamusume take on various events and have fun together with the fans.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This day has finally come!
Awesome! Let's do this, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Let's do our best together, Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! I've got to
repay all my fans for their daily support!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whenever a Satono Umamusume couldn't pull off a win,
it was the fans whose warm support kept us going.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we fell just short and were about to hang our heads,
those cheers helped us look forward again.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"So, today is our turn!
We'll win our events and thank everyone for their support!
We've gotta show our gratitude through our actions!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And starting shortly, the Pair Obstacle Race!
Once again this year, various hazards await our Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's introduce the contenders!
First up, these two:
Satono Crown & Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: As Umamusume of the Satono family, having overcome countless obstacles before, today the two of them leap over literal hurdles!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Next up are these two!
Considered the favorites to win this tournament—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Duramente & Cheval Grand!
Will we see the same formidable running from their races
here in this obstacle course!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Cheval! And Duramente!
Are you two participating in the Pair Obstacle Course too?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah. Ugh... T-To tell you the truth,
I'm not really good with this sort of thing, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: And I'd hate to... not run and let all my fans down, so...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I will prove that I am the strongest.
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you two have more than enough fighting spirit.
...Now this is getting interesting!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Without adversity on your level, I wouldn't
get fired up either! Let's do this, you two!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Dia, ready yet?
Let's go take the win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
Let's definitely take 1st place together!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Full of upsets, full of emotion! Aiming for glory
beyond the obstacles, each team—is off to a start!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
First up is the "Hop-Step Continuous Jump"!
The footholds vanish once stepped on, so the key
is leaving enough platforms for your partner behind you!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
By the way, if you fail the continuous jumps,
you'll fall victim to the sticky glue sheets laid on the ground,
resulting in a massive time loss!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa-whoa...!
T-There's nowhere to jump to...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I see.
If I just act on my own, my partner will...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Right, left, right, left...!
Is this pace all right, Kura-chan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Perfect! It's easy to jump across!
Let's run right through!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the '1,000 Pedometer Count' challenge!
Once the pedometers on your waists hit a combined
total of 1,000, you clear the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
One, two! One, two!
At this rate, we'll reach it in no time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Learning this dance from
UmaTube was totally worth it!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Team Satono has already reached the third checkpoint! Next up is
the 'Gesture Charades'! One of you will act out the prompt,
and the other has to guess who is doing what!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Got it! It's "Kitasan when she gets super hyped
at karaoke!" right?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Correct!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Duramente...!
I-I'm just not doing it right...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind.
...There's still a chance to win."

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Is that already a safety lead?!
Aside from the Satono pair, the rest are still stuck at the first and second obstacles!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*――Hǎo!
Everything's going smoothly so far!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Our practice is really paying off!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It was well worth researching beforehand
what kind of events had been held in this competition in the past.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my strategy was spot-on!
Just like in training, I was able to deliver the optimal solution!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"If we keep this up, we should be able to win
without Duramente and the others ever catching up!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Still, Kura-chan, don't let your guard down...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No problem. I understand.
I always tend to mess up at times like this, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why we brace ourselves now! Here goes our final spurt!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The final trial is the "Boulder Smash"!
If you can smash this 1-meter boulder using the provided tools, you pass!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-Boulder crushing!?
There was never anything like that in past 'Pair Obstacle Races'...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...O-Oh, that reminds me, Cla-chan!
When the two of us were reading through the materials—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There was an event called "Boulder Crushing"...?
Only once five years ago? I suppose it wasn't popular enough and got discontinued.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The chances of this event coming up seem low,
and if it's just breaking rocks, it's pretty simple—
let's spend our time on other practice!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaagh!!?
Aiya, why did I, back then...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So I just need to smash the rock, right?
There are all kinds of tools here, but I'll use this—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Ow. It hurts.
My fingertips are tingling..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Kh... To think that an event I hadn't prepared for
would show up at this point——

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
我真係……!
Why do I always have to be like this, ughhh?!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And right here!
The Duramente & Cheval Grand pair
has surged up all at once!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I can't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"E-Even I...! Want to show my good side,
at least for today...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh! Looks like we don't have much time!
We have to act immediately!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I won't give up! No matter what it takes! Together with Dia, we'll seize victory—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: "The lead pair crosses the finish line!! The winners are Duramente and Cheval Grand!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Satono Crown and Satono Diamond were passed at the very end...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh!!
So frustrating! Right at the very end!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"That was so close! Great effort!
Thanks for giving us such a thrill!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It was so fun seeing all the different events!
I'll be cheering for you again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Times like this are really when
you truly appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right... That's why
we have to make sure our feelings reach them too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry I couldn't pull off the win in today's match!
—Thank you so much for your support!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I'll live up to everyone's cheers!
I'm not going to leave them disappointed!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So, please watch me!
Next time, on the track! Without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Don't give up—!!" "You've still got this!"
"Please, show us you can win!!"
"Who cares about bad odds!" "Go for it—!!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! It's not over yet.
I'm confident!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(—Think! Think, Crown!
A pinch is the worst time to stop your brain from working!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(What I've got prepared is: a hammer, a saw,
a frying pan, scissors... But just attacking the boulder
with those isn't going to shatter it—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Then... that's it! Smash it!
If I put this on the ground and use my own body weight—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Dia, help me out! Lift this boulder and drop it right here—smack against the hammer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right... Yup!
Leave it to me, Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Ready, set――!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? What in the... what in the world!?
A crack appears in the giant boulder dropped to the ground—
I-It split!! Clean in half--!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The winners of the 'Pair Obstacle Race' are—
Satono Crown and Satono Diamond!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hao ye! Thanks for the cheers!
Thanks to you, I pulled off a victory!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaahhh!!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"At the very end, everyone's cheers gave me the
strength to push that one extra step to victory!
They gave me so much energy!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Keep watching us! Dia and I—
the Satono family will definitely keep living up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Please continue supporting me from now on as well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, Kura-chan.
I had fun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that.
Because I felt the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You know, after practicing the event with Dia, it really made me realize all over again—what incredible strength of heart that girl has.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The training must have been tough. But you never gave up,
not even for a single second...
You stayed by my side and worked hard with me the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because you're like that, I know you can win.
Do your best in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see... So that's why you worked so hard with me at the Fan Appreciation Festival, Kura-chan. Just so you could tell me that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm definitely going to win!
You have to come watch too, Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I expect nothing less than running worthy of the Satono family name!
